digest_pinned_chain.implemented: each hop receipt file is sha256-compared to record.receipt_sha256 by _digest_pinned_json_uncached; later hops come only from the pinned parent receipt's obligations[].carried_forward_from; a missing receipt, digest mismatch, or cycle ends the walk
digest_pinned_chain.sound: partially: tamper after the pin is recorded is caught, but there is no independent anchor. resolve_carry_forward computes receipt_sha256 = sha256_file(path) from the file it selects, so a modified ACCEPTED closure is self-pinned on a fresh run (control f2 accepted one). The b78b chain root is evidence/closure-ssh-b78.json (pin c255b86a..., which we reproduced); its hop to evidence/closure-ssh-b76c.json is pinned inside that receipt. Both anchors are computed at run time, not checked against a committed manifest

ancestor_is_definition_line.implemented: resolve_operation_at_line at the hop head; span.def_line != hop.line -> skip
ancestor_is_definition_line.sound: yes for the coordinate-vs-definition requirement (control c refused)

ancestor_body_equals_boundary_hash.implemented: hits filtered to span_sha256 == boundary.span_sha256; all resolving hops must agree (len(set(hash)) > 1 -> None); the unchanged candidate check recorded != boundary_span.sha256 still runs
ancestor_body_equals_boundary_hash.sound: yes as a content check (control d refused span-hash-mismatch); it is only as trustworthy as the boundary's recorded hash, which load_boundaries reads from an unpinned receipt

uniqueness_exactly_one_boundary.implemented: migration_bindings over boundaries_by_file; adjudicate binds only when len(map) == 1; two ids matching -> refuse (control b)
uniqueness_exactly_one_boundary.sound: yes for owner uniqueness; it counts non-discharging and superseded boundaries too (over-refusal only), and keys by id so same-id duplicates collapse rather than count twice (no false discharge found)

different_operation_same_name.implemented: qualification is used by resolve_operation_span (an unqualified name with several definitions refuses), and scope_item is only the last component for the obligation/boundary filter
different_operation_same_name.sound: no: no check compares the ancestor hit's qualified identity with the boundary's resolved qualified identity. Control a bound a row whose ancestor coordinate was m1::copyctx's definition line to a boundary for m2::copyctx because the bodies were byte-identical. The seven real rows are not affected because all copyctx bodies in src/provider/digest.rs and src/provider/legacyprov.rs have distinct hashes at the candidate (we recomputed all 6 + 2), but the mechanism has no contract that establishes this

prior_refusal.implemented: no persistent refusal state; adjudicate recomputes from receipts. The arm is reached only for the span-unparsable class (candidate coordinate names no definition), and the disposition/conflict/hash/identity gates still run after it
prior_refusal.sound: it intentionally re-admits the coordinate refusal class (the seven rows), but cannot re-admit a RETAINED/withdrawn disposition (control e), a current-hash mismatch (d), a tampered pin (f1), or a coordinate the chain does not name. It inherits the pre-existing diagnostic-only conflict gate: a boundary withdrawn only by a same-operation BLOCKED disposition in another receipt still discharges unless --enforce-disposition-conflicts is set
